notes.title: New DX version to celebrate new game ChainStaff.
notes.content:
I'm releasing the DX update for free to players who already own the game!
This is to celebrate the reveal of my next game:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/[/url]
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2976260/header.jpg?t=1718126766https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2976260/header.jpg?t=1718126766[/img]
[h2]Please [b]wishlist [/b][i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/]ChainStaff[/url][/i] today! It's a big help to me, as it helps support me as I keep making new games. As a thank you--here's all the new DX changes for Weapon of Choice![/h2]

[list]
[*] Uprezzed graphics to 4K resolution!
[*] Improved performance to consistent 60fps!
[*] Gameplay improvements: Player jump is quicker, enemies have been rebalanced for more fair challenge!
[*] Improved readability for "Deathbrushing", UI, and cinema scenes.
[/list]

Weapon of Choice is my oldest indie game, and when I ported it to Steam back in 2015, I added a lot of cool things back then: Like widescreen mode, hidden collectibles, and keyboard + mouse controls. All those improvements are still here, and the DX version is even more polished and with better gameplay balance. 

Thank you for playing Weapon of Choice DX and all my Mommy's Best Games!

-Nathan
Mommy's Best Games

notes.title: XBLIG Escapees: Mommy s Best Games On PC
notes.content:
Xbox Live Indie Games has felt like an outpost of PC gaming on Xbox 360. It’s a space like Newgrounds, Game Jolt, or Itch, where anyone can make and release small games, which means its library of thousands has everything from scrappy gag games to some really pretty great stuff. And like PC gaming, Microsoft had no idea what to do with XBLIG – they hid the space away for years, and are now planning to close it.

But! Good (and RPS-relevant) news: four games from prolific XBLIG dev Mommy’s Best Games – who you might know for the gun-stacking Serious Sam Double D – have arrived on Steam, giving a small peek into the world.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Weapon of Choice
notes.content:
Weapon of Choice is Now Available on Steam!

Weapon of Choice is a high-energy, side-scroller in which each playable character is unique with their own special weapon and abilities! Blast insane aliens, find new player characters, and choose between branching paths!
